hints.title: Polynomial Algebraic Simplification
hints.text: Represent expressions as polynomials mapping sorted tuples of variables to their integer coefficient.

hints.title: Polynomial Addition, Subtraction, and Multiplication
hints.text: Substitute evaluated values for known variables. Polynomial addition merges like terms; multiplication convolves terms by concatenating variable lists and multiplying coefficients.

hints.title: Recursive Expression Parsing Blueprint
hints.text: Parse expression with shunting-yard or recursive descent using precedence rules: * before + and -. Format output by sorting terms by descending degree then lexicographically.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of operations in expression
